title: Temple of the Tooth
scope: The public western entrance of Sri Dalada Maligawa, Paththirippuwa, stone moat walls, original shrine courtyard and current gilded canopy at Kandy.
limitations: The historic ceremonial entrance and main temple are covered. The independently named palace, audience hall, museums and lakeside pavilions are outside this model.
Ancillary western roof lines, stone reliefs, fine timber carvings and canopy dimensions are approximated from the map, archival views and recorded specifications.
